preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)
Attacker must hold some 1SHIBA tokens to demonstrate fee impact

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() to increase fees to maximum values (e.g., 99%). Then perform token transfers to trigger fee collection. The increased fees will be distributed to the marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110) and liquidity pool, potentially allowing the owner to extract value through the marketing address or liquidity removal.
